interface.shortDescription: Your own AI for your Hiro show: 31 playbooks on your real numbers
interface.longDescription: Hiro sells private podcasts and audio courses for coaches, course creators and authors. This plugin gives Claude the /hiro skill: 31 ready-made playbooks that work from your show's Show Soul (who it is for, your voice, best moments, goals) and the live numbers Hiro already has (downloads, visits, opt-ins, sales, completion). Set up the soul, learn your voice from your episodes, write this week's email, plan the next six episodes, find which episode loses people, or get a plan to hit a listener number by a date. It uses the Hiro.fm connector, so connect your Hiro account first at app.hiro.fm/ai/mcp. No Hiro credits are used.
defaultPrompt: What's the one thing holding my show back right now?
Write this week's email to my listeners about my newest episode
